allowed_changes: reuse exact F-CURVE risk-on rule latest usable T-1 FRED T10Y3M > 0 with max stale 7 calendar days
risk-on target fixed at 20% each gold_cny/Nasdaq/S&P500/CSI300/Shanghai Composite
rebalance on curve state changes and at calendar-year boundaries while risk-on
always-risk annual-rebalanced 20%-each control and CNY cash control
product-level 1.00% fee + 0.05% slippage with no fee grid
expected_outputs: risk-on session count, trades, cash, realized gross and target fingerprint
global post-protocol DSR after formal run
run authorization, execution commit and SHA artifact manifest
follow_up_policy: After formal metrics are viewed, no curve threshold, alternate yield spread, delay, persistence, basket weight, asset set, rebalance cadence or confirmation filter rescue is allowed in this lineage. Any such rule is a new preregistered economic hypothesis.
forbidden_changes: post-inversion delays, uninversion delays or recession-confirmation rules
moving average, percentile or persistence filters
changing risk basket weights or assets after results
adding VIX, NFCI, trend, momentum or drawdown confirmation
shorting, financing, borrowing, leverage, gross >100% or negative cash
hypothesis: A positive U.S. 10-year minus 3-month Treasury spread identifies normal credit-cycle conditions, while inversion identifies a late-cycle risk regime. Holding a fixed diversified risk basket only while the latest causal T-1 T10Y3M observation is positive, and otherwise holding CNY demand cash, should preserve much of broad-asset return while reducing major bear-market drawdowns with very low state-change turnover.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
selection_metric: No threshold or lag selection. Reuse the already-frozen F-CURVE zero-spread sign and seven-calendar-day stale semantics exactly. Validation, objective attainment and comparison versus always-risk are separate ATM-SVP-3 axes.
